title: Forced onto bass at a Young Men Olympia funeral
summary: At a Young Men Olympia funeral with Dominic Remy leading, the hired bass player did not show up, and Clark was made to play the bass. He bought a fingering chart and taught himself.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique

blocks.x: You heard of him though, yeah? Well we hired him to play bass. But he didn't have a bass so we got the bass from our bass player which was sick Pete Blanchett. So we brought the bass over to the hall and we waited for him and he didn't come. And it was time to leave. So T-Boy said to me, he says, go in the hall and get that bass. I says, I can't play no bass man. Go get the bass like I'm telling you. Well I went and got the bass but I had never played bass before. I've had them in my hands but I never even tried to play them.

I could feel the horn all right. So she just go ahead. Said that'll make the band, the band won't look short. Even if you can't play the bass the band would have looked for them. So we made that funeral. So when we got in he says to me, he says, you take that bass home. I'm going to Pete and tell Pete that you got that bass and I'm responsible for it. You go to World Airlines and you buy your chart. Just for the finger, not the music. You know the music. The music is the same. And I went to World Airlines and bought a chart the next day. And I came on home. So my wife says, well, what you going to do now? I says, well I'm going to try to play this bass. And I sit there with that bass and I just kept on. And I've never taken a lesson from nobody, not on the bass. No more than that chart I learnt the finger. To take a lesson on the bass I got to take that chance. So dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear
